# Tool and skill registry

<!-- Generated by npm run registry from mcp/ and plugins/genobi/skills/. Do not edit; change the tool definition or the skill's frontmatter. -->

Every tool of the Genobi MCP server and every skill of the plugin, grouped by tag: 53 tools and 22 skills. Each tool links to the skills that teach it and the docs behind it; [the tools page](registry-tools.md) and [the skills page](registry-skills.md) hold each one's full description.

The pages are rendered from [`plugins/genobi/registry.json`](https://github.com/koshimazaki/Genobi/blob/main/plugins/genobi/registry.json), which `npm run registry` generates from the tool definitions in `mcp/` and the skills' frontmatter. Agents search the same file with `genobi_registry`. `npm run check:registry` fails when the file or these pages are stale.

For features rather than tools (where each one is in the studio, whether it runs free and local, on a local open model, on Comfy Cloud or through a paid API, and its status), see [the capability map](capabilities.md).
